description: This file defines an interface 'VoicemailProviderHelper' that provides methods for manipulating voicemail data within a content provider, including CRUD operations, setting content, and retrieving voicemail entries. It also includes an inner enum 'SortOrder' for sorting options.

classes.name: VoicemailProviderHelper
classes.description: An interface that provides methods for managing voicemails in a content provider, including inserting, updating, deleting, retrieving, and setting content. Also includes sorting options via the inner enum 'SortOrder'.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all voicemails accessible to this content provider and returns the count of deleted voicemails.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new voicemail into the content provider and returns the URI of the newly created voicemail.

methods.name: findVoicemailBySourceData
methods.description: Retrieves a Voicemail object that matches the given provider data string.

methods.name: findVoicemailByUri
methods.description: Retrieves a Voicemail object that matches the given URI.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing voicemail identified by its URI with the data in the provided Voicemail object.

methods.name: setVoicemailContent
methods.description: Sets the content of a voicemail from an InputStream for a specified URI.

methods.name: setVoicemailContent
methods.description: Sets the content of a voicemail from a byte array for a specified URI.

methods.name: getAllVoicemails
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all voicemails without guarantees on order.

methods.name: getAllVoicemails
methods.description: Retrieves a sorted and optionally filtered list of voicemails based on specified criteria.

methods.name: getUriForVoicemailWithId
methods.description: Returns the URI corresponding to a voicemail with the specified ID.
